        -- TSS
        ROUND(CAST((1.0 - sd.tempdevcount::numeric/100.0) * (1.0 - sd.critevents::numeric/10.0) * sd.tempstabidx AS numeric), 4) AS tss,
        -- CRI = (1 - TSS) * (1 - CoolRemainPct/100)
        ROUND(CAST((1.0 - (1.0 - sd.tempdevcount::numeric/100.0) * (1.0 - sd.critevents::numeric/10.0) * sd.tempstabidx) * (1.0 - c.coolremainpct::numeric/100.0) AS numeric), 4) AS cri

    JOIN container c ON ti.containtransit = c.containregistry
    JOIN sensordata sd ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry
)
SELECT *, 
    CASE WHEN rcp < 50 AND cri > 0.4 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Normal' END AS risk_status
FROM base LIMIT 10;
